hypothesis: The original recovery premise has failed when a held completed close breaks the entire pre-entry pullback low, before the C51 profit guard has ever armed.
floor: min lows of q+1 through original signal i, inclusive; q is C54's last pre-pullback close above native EMA20
availability: floor fixed at original signal close; require at least one pullback bar; only held completed closes strictly before parent exit decision and guard activation
preflight_outputs: counts and original outcome labels only; no new exit price, candidate net or alternative scan
decision: Do not claim improvement or run a rule without observable target events in both used periods. This is an applicability screen not a significance gate.
